messages.Copernicus Sentinel-2 true-colour imager: Sawirrada midabbada dabiiciga ah ee Copernicus Sentinel-2 waxay taageeraan baaritaanka muuqaalka; daruuruhu way qarin karaan biyaha. Dejintiisa cloudCoverage=100 waxay oggolaanaysaa sawirro daruuro leh; ma cabbirto daruuraha deegaanka. Sawirrada Sentinel-2 Browser ma aha il digniineed. Copernicus CEMS Global Flood Monitoring ayaa bixiya kala soocidda fatahaadda ee raadaarka ee gaarka ah ee khariidadda ka muuqata. Heerarka sare waxay tilmaamayaan meelo u baahan baaritaan. Tani ma aha fatahaad la arkay, saadaal fatahaad, qoto-dheeraanta biyaha, muddada celcelis ahaan u dhexeysa fatahaado heer gaar ah leh ama xog naqshad injineernimo.
messages.Union of SWALIM historical flood extents: Isku-darka baaxadihii fatahaadaha hore ee SWALIM: Deyr 2023, Gu 2021, Gu/Hagaa 2020, Gu/Deyr 2019, Gu/Deyr 2018, Gu 2016, Gu 2015 iyo Deyr 2013. Waxay muujinaysaa meelihii fatahaadda lagu khariidadeeyay xilliyadaas; in meel aanay ku jirin baaxaddan ma caddaynayso badbaado, lakabkuna ma aha baaxadda fatahaadda ee hadda.
messages.SWALIM Shabelle riverbank assessment fro: Qiimeynta SWALIM ee jiinka Shabeelle oo laga sameeyay sawirro aad u faahfaahsan. Xaaladda bar kastaa waxay qeexaysaa wixii la arkay taariikhda sawirkeeda. Fasiraadda sawirrada meel fog laga qaaday waxay leedahay hubin goobta ah oo kooban. Xaaladda hadda iyo xaaladda dayactirku waxay u baahan yihiin hubin goobta ah. Qiimeynta Agoosto ma daboolayso Webiga Jubba.
Qiimeynta Jubba iyo Shabeelle ee Maarso 2026. Adeegso shaandhada river=Juba marka lagu darayo lakabka cusub ee Shabeelle si looga fogaado baraha Shabeelle ee soo noqnoqda ama duugga ah. Taariikhda waxa la arkay ma aha xaaladda jiinka webiga ee hadda.
